title: Skill run snapshot
description: One observability record per skill run (or per turn with SKILL_OBS_LOG_ALL=1). `raw` holds verbatim material copied from the hook payload and transcripts; `computed` holds every derived value. The two never mix: a consumer that wants ground truth reads raw, a dashboard reads computed, and computed can always be re-derived from raw (cost via pricing_version).

run_id.description: Deterministic per-record id: <session8>-<line_from>-<line_to>. The join key for subagent_runs.spawned_by_run_id (see KPIs.md)

skills.description: Distinct skill/command names detected in the window

raw.description: Verbatim, untransformed material. usage_entries[].usage is the exact message.usage object from the transcript line, including per-TTL cache_creation split, service_tier, speed, server_tool_use, and iterations.

hook_payload.description: The stdin JSON the hook received, verbatim

dispatch_results.description: toolUseResult objects from Agent/Task dispatches, verbatim

tool_calls.description: tool_use names/ids/timestamps in the window (no inputs/outputs)

computed.description: Derived values only. Everything here is re-derivable from raw.

boundary_total.description: Final-turn four-way sum over top-level session usage — the dispatch-boundary quantity per docs/specs/2026-07-31-token-measurement-contract.md

by_model.description: Per model: { usd, marginal_usd, context_carry_usd, rates } — rates carry the exact prices used, incl. variant (standard/fast/introductory)

total_usd.description: marginal_usd + context_carry_usd; null when any model in the window has no pricing entry

marginal_usd.description: Cost of input + output + cache writes — spend the run itself caused. The skill-efficiency number, comparable across session depths ONLY from about session line 25 onward: a fresh session writes the prompt cache from scratch, so marginal/call measures ~45,619 at depth 5-9 and ~19,531 at 10-24 against ~6,757-11,647 past line 25. Check computed.attribution.marginal_comparable before comparing (METRICS.md)

context_carry_usd.description: Cost of cache reads — the session-depth tax of running mid-session

attribution.description: The window is the TURN; the run is the SKILL. The hook's window runs cursor->EOF (which is what guarantees no spend is counted twice), but a skill invoked partway through it did not cause the spend that preceded it — measured 49% contamination on one real record. This block splits the window at the invocation boundary. attributed + unattributed always reconcile to computed.tokens/cost: it is a partition, not a filter.

invocation_line.description: WINDOW-relative line of the first invocation (detectInvocations runs on the sliced window). Not a session depth — add session_depth_lines

session_depth_lines.description: window.line_from: how deep in the session this window opened

invocation_depth_lines.description: ABSOLUTE session line of the invocation (session_depth_lines + invocation_line). The value session_start is computed from

session_start.description: Human-readable reason a cost may be an outlier. fresh (<25): the session is writing the prompt cache from scratch, so marginal/call runs ~2-4x high AND carry runs low. warming (25-399): marginal has settled; cache read/call still climbing. steady (>=400): read/call has plateaued (within 5% across four buckets), so total_usd is comparable too. Null when no skill ran in the window (SKILL_OBS_LOG_ALL turn records). Boundaries measured over 298 sessions; 22.1% of 494 real invocations land in fresh

fresh_session.description: session_start === 'fresh', as a boolean for a dashboard badge

marginal_comparable.description: Whether marginal_usd may be compared to other runs without a caveat. False only for fresh, where the cache-write spike makes BOTH cost figures outliers, not just context carry

attributed.description: { tokens, cost, api_calls } for spend at/after the invocation — the skill's own cost

unattributed.description: { tokens, cost, api_calls } for the pre-invocation tail of the turn. Reported rather than discarded so the split always reconciles

policy.description: The attribution rule in prose, so an old record explains itself

active_ms.description: Gap-capped: idle stretches longer than gap_cap_ms count as gap_cap_ms

subagent_runs.description: The subagent join table (derived; raw.subagents stays verbatim). One row per agent with new activity in this window.

file.description: agent-<id>.jsonl — stable per agent across records

tool_use_id.description: Joins to the Agent/Task call in the spawning record's raw.tool_calls / raw.dispatch_results

spawned_by_run_id.description: run_id of the record whose window first saw this agent; null = spawned in an unlogged turn
